idea-plugin.name: KMP Translations Hub
idea-plugin.description:
Every translation of your Compose Multiplatform app in one table, and only what changed gets translated.

  • A Translations tab on every composeResources/values… XML file: all keys of the module against all locales, with search and filters for missing, problem and outdated translations.
  • Strings, plurals and string-arrays. Edits keep your files' formatting and comments; each is one Undo.
  • Add, rename and delete keys in every locale at once; add a locale.
  • Checks for missing translations, placeholders that don't match the default text, array sizes and keys left behind, in the tab and as warnings in the XML editor.
  • ⌘/Ctrl+click Res.string.hello to jump to its XML; a gutter icon on each key finds its uses.
  • Translate Changes: only missing and outdated strings, every locale at once, placeholders protected. Apple on-device translation and MyMemory need no key; or use your own DeepL, Google Cloud, Claude or OpenAI key.
  • Plural forms each language needs (Arabic 6, Polish 4, Japanese 1), and checks for escapes, untranslated text, length and unused keys.
  • Extract hardcoded strings from Compose UI code to composeResources, one at a time or the whole project.
  • Sync with Crowdin, Lokalise and POEditor: upload the default strings, download your translators' work, and upload translations made in the IDE. A translation changed on both sides is never overwritten without asking.
  • Import and export CSV, XLIFF 1.2 and Android strings.xml for translators.
  • Run in this locale on an Android device or iOS simulator, with KMP Device Hub.

Every feature is free. If it saves you time, you can support its development on Ko-fi or Buy Me a Coffee.
